title: Fracture sprain immobilization and circulation check
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for supporting an injured limb and checking color, warmth, sensation, and movement.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: deformity, bone visible, numb fingers, blue toes, severe swelling, or uncontrolled pain.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: deformity, bone visible, numb fingers, blue toes, severe swelling, or uncontrolled pain

title: Crush injury danger record
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for recording trapped time, body part, pain, urine changes, and urgent transfer need.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: trapped limb, severe swelling, dark urine, weakness, collapse, or long pressure time.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: trapped limb, severe swelling, dark urine, weakness, collapse, or long pressure time

title: Eye injury no-rub shield rule
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for protecting the eye without pressure while seeking urgent care.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: penetrating object, chemical splash, vision loss, severe pain, blood in eye, or metal grinding injury.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: penetrating object, chemical splash, vision loss, severe pain, blood in eye, or metal grinding injury
